title: Korar Ɗan Maraƙin Zinare
intro: Wani mutum da aka ambata a cikin Alƙur'ani ya jagoranci jama'a masu yawa zuwa ga karkacewa a lokacin da babu wani annabi mai daraja. Wani abu da aka ƙera da zinariya ya kama zukatan al'umma gaba ɗaya - amma labarin wannan mutumin ya ƙare da kaɗaici da la'ana mai ban mamaki. Wanene wannan wanda aka kore?
clues: Na fito ne a lokacin rashin wani babban annabi wanda ya hau sama don samun shiriya daga Allah.
Na sa taron jama'a da yawa su ɓace da wani abu da na ƙera da hannuna.
Halittar zinare da na samar ta yi kama da tana da rai, tana samar da sautuka da ke burge waɗanda suka bi ta.
Na yi iƙirarin na ga abin da wasu ba za su iya gani ba - wani ɗan gajeren bayani game da abin da ba a gani ba.
Na zaro wani abu daga cikin sawun manzon allah na jefa shi cikin ƙarfe mai narkewa.
An yanke min hukunci na yi yawo ni kaɗai, da wata la'ana ta musamman wadda babu wanda zai iya taɓa fatata ko kuma ni ma in taɓa ta.

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Korarsa, an hana shi taɓawa ko taɓa wasu

outcome.answer: Korarsa, an hana shi taɓawa ko taɓa wasu

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
